conventions.responses: Every response is a JSON object with "schema" (its schema's name: #/components/schemas/<schema> in openapi.json) and "version" (the API version, 1). HTTP responses also link it: Link: <...openapi.json#/components/schemas/<schema>>; rel="describedby".
conventions.errors: A failure is {"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}} (#/components/schemas/Error) with the HTTP status of its code: bad_request 400, forbidden 403, not_found 404, conflict 409, no_server 503, internal 500.
conventions.reads: GET /api/v1/<function>?<param>=<value>: no token; numbers and booleans as text (true/false), arrays as JSON.
conventions.actions: POST /api/v1/<function> with a JSON object of the parameters, header X-Perflab-Token (the server's token, in ~/.perflab/server/token), from the server's own origin only.
conventions.project: Every function on a project takes `project`: a project id (see projects) or its root directory; over HTTP only registered projects, and omitted only when there is one.
conventions.urls: Fields named url are paths on the server (http://127.0.0.1:8690 by default, or the name a local proxy gives it, such as https://perflab.localhost): the index, timelines, flame graphs.
conventions.units: A metric's unit is in its label (MetricInfo.label): the score in the benchmark's unit (e.g. ms/op), alloc in bytes per op, counts in events per op (per unit of perUnit when the spec has one), ratios and percents as such.
conventions.statistics: The unit of variation is the fork: a variant's mean, sd and 99.9% CI are over its forks' means; Δ is by Welch's t (`forkVerdict`), significant when |pct| > halfWidth. `jmh` has what JMH reports for these forks as one run, which the index shows first and `verdict` goes by: every iteration pooled, the score their mean, the error t(N − 1) × sd / √N at 99.9% (none with N ≤ 2).
